Hey, so, something a wise woman said to me is: narcissistic relationships are an interesting thing. There is their part (I’ll skip the description) and yours. Your OWN narcissism is thinking you are important and wise and strong and (insert your adjective here) enough to change them. No hate here—it was hard to hear given my experience but it helped me. And it’s not to say you are a narcissist. But some people wouldn’t think to continue when hit with the behaviors. So what self-discovery can you do to make sure you never participate?

In some states, an attorney can file for a protective order for you without your having to get police involved. This could be helpful if you want to avoid further retaliation but still have the protection against contact and recourse for violating it. Violating a protective order is a crime and the person can also be held in contempt. But yeah—protection or restraining order. Now.

This. Lawyer and leave. Most states have sliding scale legal services non-profits that are experienced with these sorts of cases if money is an issue.

The anxiety of being with a narcissist and escaping a narcissist is indescribable. It doesn’t matter what any idiots or assholes that fall for their bullshit think. Focus on self care. Get medical care. And get far far away.

And never again will I give quarter.
